dateAssessment:
The working campaign date is October 5, DR 1740, from the compatible YAML span. Only the year 1740 is independently spoken (t05); Ayveen explicitly says the party does not know how long it has been here. The watch below is the host’s stated local evening (t04), not a civil watch inferred from the stationary sunset. It groups the continuing manor visit without synchronizing Feywild time to the Material Plane.

Tarek’s powder takes effect after a few minutes, and the house is sideways for about a minute (t01–t02). Kaito’s ten-to-fifteen-minute entertainment attempt (t03) belongs to the manor visit, whose cumulative duration Ayveen estimates at about an hour (t06); these are not three successive advances. The accepted ten-minute ritual is a separate wait before reading the books (t07). The later zero chime (t08) is an event trigger, not midnight. No completed short or long rest or day transition occurs. River-loop and final walking durations remain open.

Menestheus’s old arrival date is historical background: 1054 is questioned, 1041 is suggested, and the DM finally says “the appropriate year, late in October” (i020, u2495–u2514). That passage supplies no current adventure date and is retained without choosing a final historical year.

watches.summary: Host calls it evening; manor visit about an hour, followed by ten-minute ritual. Zero chimes supply no civil hour.
